sentences.en: Humans and birds don't have much in common.
sentences.zh: 人类和鸟类没有太多共同点.

sentences.en: For example, most birds can fly, and most humans can't.
sentences.zh: 例如，大多数鸟类会飞，而大多数人类不会.

sentences.en: But one thing we do have in common is that humans and birds both love to play tourists in New York City.
sentences.zh: 但我们确实有一个共同点，那就是人类和鸟类都喜欢在纽约市装游客.

sentences.en: Every year, millions of birds fly to New York on their annual migration.
sentences.zh: 每年，数百万只鸟类在年度迁徙时飞往纽约.

sentences.en: And because flying several thousand miles is pretty exhausting,
sentences.zh: 而且因为飞行数千英里相当累人，

sentences.en: these birds nest for a few days in one of NYC's many urban parks.
sentences.zh: 这些鸟类会在纽约众多城市公园之一筑巢几天.

sentences.en: I live really near Brooklyn Bridge Park, and I basically walked in the park almost every day of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 我住得离布鲁克林大桥公园非常近，在大流行期间，我基本上几乎每天都在公园里散步.

sentences.en: But I always saw it through the eyes of, you know, somebody who's an architecture critic.
sentences.zh: 但我总是通过你知道的、某种建筑评论员的眼光来看待它.

sentences.en: But I never really perceived it as a bird habitat.
sentences.zh: 但我从未真正把它看作是鸟类的栖息地.

sentences.en: This is design critic and friend of the show, Alexandra Lang.
sentences.zh: 这位是设计评论员兼本节目好友，亚历山德拉·朗.

sentences.en: I would see people, you know, tweeting pictures of birds from Brooklyn Bridge Park.
sentences.zh: 我会看到人们，你知道的，在推特上发布从布鲁克林大桥公园拍的鸟类照片.

sentences.en: And so I'd think, oh, I should, you know, notice those.
sentences.zh: 所以我会想，哦，我应该，你知道的，注意到这些.

sentences.en: But I just, it's like I didn't know how to notice them.
sentences.zh: 但我只是，就好像我不知道该怎么注意到它们一样.

sentences.en: Alexandra wanted to know more about the birds passing through her city
sentences.zh: 亚历山德拉想更多地了解路过她城市的鸟类

sentences.en: and wrote an article about it for the website City Lab.
sentences.zh: 并为此在“城市实验室”网站上写了一篇文章.

sentences.en: Last November, she emailed two local birders,
sentences.zh: 去年11月，她给两位当地的观鸟者发了电子邮件，

sentences.en: and they showed her all the birds quietly nesting in her favorite park.
sentences.zh: 他们向她展示了所有在她最喜欢的公园里安静筑巢的鸟类.

sentences.en: And then we have the raven's neSt.
So the raven's nested on the tower of the Brooklyn Bridge.
sentences.zh: 所以乌鸦在布鲁克林大桥的塔楼上筑巢了.

sentences.en: And that's the third, the third ever on record raven neSt.
sentences.zh: 那是历史记录上的第三个，第三个乌鸦巢.

sentences.en: They showed me this bird that they called the butter butt.
sentences.zh: 他们给我看了一只他们称之为“黄屁股”的鸟.

sentences.en: Some people call them butter butts.
sentences.zh: 有些人称它们为黄屁股.

sentences.en: Its real name is the yellow rump warbler.
Just FYI, I don't know if that's any more dignified than butter butt, but, you know.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，我不知道这是否比黄屁股更有尊严，但你知道的.

sentences.en: It was so fun to see just that, like, flash of bright yellow in the park.
sentences.zh: 看到公园里那一抹亮黄色，真的太有趣了.

sentences.en: You know, it was already November.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当时已经是11月了.

sentences.en: Like, everything was very gray and brown and kind of sear.
sentences.zh: 就像，万物都是灰褐色的，而且有点干枯.

sentences.en: And just to have somebody point and see that, like, flash of yellow, that was just great.
sentences.zh: 只要有人指着看到那一抹黄色，那就太棒了.

sentences.en: But as Alexandra walked through the park, she noticed something else,
sentences.zh: 但当亚历山德拉穿过公园时，她注意到了另一件事，
一件让她感到不安的事.

sentences.en: While Brooklyn Bridge Park is a safe haven for birds,
sentences.zh: 虽然布鲁克林大桥公园是鸟类的安全避难所，

sentences.en: the park is surrounded by condos and hotels and office buildings with floor-to-ceiling windows.
sentences.zh: 但公园四周环绕着装有落地窗的公寓、酒店和办公楼.

sentences.en: These all-glass building facades are the absolute worst for migrating birds.
sentences.zh: 这些全玻璃的建筑立面对迁徙的鸟类来说绝对是最糟糕的.

sentences.en: Because unlike people, birds don't really understand glass.
sentences.zh: 因为与人类不同，鸟类并不真正理解玻璃.

sentences.en: I mean, this has happened in cities all over the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这在全美各地的城市都发生过

sentences.en: that there's been this boom in urban parks,
sentences.zh: 城市公园出现了这种繁荣，

sentences.en: but those parks booms also spur real estate development.
sentences.zh: 但这些公园的繁荣也刺激了房地产开发.

sentences.en: It's glass buildings, because those are what we think of as fancy new architecture.
sentences.zh: 这是玻璃建筑，因为这些被我们认为是时髦的新建筑.

sentences.en: Anytime you have glass and birds in the same space,
sentences.zh: 任何时候，只要玻璃和鸟类在同一个空间里，

sentences.en: you have a risk of bird window collisions.
sentences.zh: 你就会面临鸟类撞击窗户的风险.

sentences.en: This is Caitlin Parkins, the Interim Director of Conservation and Science
sentences.zh: 这是凯特琳·帕金斯，她是纽约奥杜邦学会

sentences.en: oh, birds are so dumb, they just run into glass.
sentences.zh: 哦，鸟太笨了，它们只会撞上玻璃.

sentences.en: And if you step back and think of it, it's made not to be seen, right?
sentences.zh: 如果你退一步想想，它就是被制造得让人看不见，对吧？

sentences.en: It's made so that we can look through our window and get a beautiful view of the outdoors.
sentences.zh: 它的制造是为了让我们能够透过窗户获得户外的美景.

sentences.en: We see glass because we use architectural cues to recognize that it's present,
sentences.zh: 我们能看到玻璃是因为我们使用建筑线索来识别它的存在，

sentences.en: or we've learned some of the nuance of the color of glass,
sentences.zh: 或者我们已经了解了玻璃颜色的某些细微差别，

sentences.en: or maybe there's a mark on the glass that makes us realize,
sentences.zh: 或者也许玻璃上有个标记让我们意识到，

sentences.en: okay, this is a solid barrier.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这是一个坚固的屏障.

sentences.en: Birds can't really pick up on those cues.
sentences.zh: 鸟类其实无法察觉这些线索.

sentences.en: This is especially bad if there's anything behind the glass the bird recognizes, like a plant.
sentences.zh: 如果有任何鸟类认出的东西（比如植物）在玻璃后面，情况就会特别糟糕.

sentences.en: So if you can imagine a really reflective piece of glass,
sentences.zh: 所以如果你能想象一块反光很强的玻璃，

sentences.en: and there's a tree in it,
a bird is going to see that and recognize it as a tree and try to fly to it.
sentences.zh: 鸟看到这个就会把它认作是一棵树并试图飞向它.

sentences.en: And they're very fast, and they hit very hard, and often they die instantly.
sentences.zh: 它们飞得很快，撞击得很猛烈，而且通常会当场死亡.

sentences.en: Another example, this is an ecological trap, but we put vegetation behind glass.
sentences.zh: 另一个例子，这是一个生态陷阱，但我们将植被放在玻璃后面.

sentences.en: We love atriums with trees in them.
sentences.zh: 我们喜欢里面有树的中庭.

sentences.en: We want to bring nature indoors.
sentences.zh: 我们想把大自然带到室内.

sentences.en: Well, then you're actually just putting a clear piece of glass between a tree and a bird.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那你实际上只是在树和鸟之间放了一块透明的玻璃.

sentences.en: And of course they're going to try to fly to the tree and rest and hit the glass and potentially die.
sentences.zh: 当然，它们会试图飞向树去休息，然后撞到玻璃并可能死亡.

sentences.en: The world is incredibly perilous for birds.
sentences.zh: 这个世界对鸟类来说极其危险.
风力发电机能杀死鸟类.

sentences.en: And on top of that, pet cats kill so many birds.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，宠物猫杀死了大量的鸟.

sentences.en: Truly, cats are out of control.
However, it's believed that building collisions are one of the biggest causes of bird death.
sentences.zh: 然而，人们认为建筑物撞击是鸟类死亡的最大原因之一.

sentences.en: Birds crash into buildings during the day because they don't see the glass.
sentences.zh: 鸟类在白天撞上建筑物是因为它们看不到玻璃.

sentences.en: And they run into buildings at night because they are lured in by artificial lighting.
sentences.zh: 它们在夜间撞进建筑物是因为被人工照明诱惑.

sentences.en: Most of these collisions happen below 100 feet,
sentences.zh: 这些撞击大多发生在100英尺以下，

sentences.en: because that's where birds are used to landing in trees.
sentences.zh: 因为那是鸟类习惯在树上降落的高度.

sentences.en: This loss is awful for so many reasons.
sentences.zh: 这种损失由于种种原因令人痛心.

sentences.en: Birds are essential for controlling pests and pollinating flowers and regenerating forests.
sentences.zh: 鸟类对于控制害虫、给花授粉和恢复森林至关重要.

sentences.en: And watching birds and listening to birdsong is just really nice.
sentences.zh: 而且观赏鸟类和聆听鸟鸣真的非常美好.

sentences.en: We don't have exact numbers on how many birds we kill because there is no bird census.
sentences.zh: 我们没有关于我们杀死了多少鸟的准确数字，因为没有鸟类普查.

sentences.en: But even the lowest estimates are devastating.
sentences.zh: 但即使是最低的估计也是毁灭性的.

sentences.en: According to the Audubon Society, buildings kill 300 million to a billion birds per year.
sentences.zh: 根据奥杜邦学会的数据，建筑物每年杀死3亿到10亿只鸟.

sentences.en: I mean, that's the high end of the estimate.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那是估计的高端.

sentences.en: Like these are definitely like I noticed when I was looking back through the stats.
sentences.zh: 就像这些绝对是我在回顾统计数据时注意到的.

sentences.en: These collisions are a major reason the bird population in North America is in decline.
sentences.zh: 这些撞击是北美鸟类数量下降的一个主要原因.

sentences.en: One study found that we've lost 3 billion birds since the 1970s.
sentences.zh: 一项研究发现，自20世纪70年代以来，我们已经失去了30亿只鸟.

sentences.en: Again, we don't have exact numbers,
sentences.zh: 再说一次，我们没有确切的数字，

sentences.en: which is why organizations around the world hold collision walks.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么世界各地的组织会举行撞击寻迹散步.

sentences.en: Every week, groups like NYC Audubon organize volunteers
sentences.zh: 每周，像纽约奥杜邦这样的组织都会组织志愿者

sentences.en: to document the number of dead birds next to skyscrapers.
sentences.zh: 去记录摩天大楼旁死鸟的数量.

sentences.en: It started back in 1997 when one of our board members
sentences.zh: 这一切始于1997年，当时我们的董事会成员之一

sentences.en: started just noticing dead birds on the sidewalk
sentences.zh: 开始注意到人行道上有死鸟

sentences.en: and actually didn't even know what was causing it.
sentences.zh: 甚至不知道是什么原因造成的.

sentences.en: And she and some volunteers started walking the streets,
sentences.zh: 她和一些志愿者开始走上街头，
记录鸟类撞击窗户事件，

sentences.en: and of course transporting injured birds to rehabilitation centers.
sentences.zh: 当然还有将受伤的鸟类运送到康复中心.

sentences.en: So when our volunteers find a bird that's been stunned,
sentences.zh: 所以当我们的志愿者发现一只被撞晕的鸟时，

sentences.en: they put it into a paper bag.
sentences.zh: 他们把它放进一个纸袋里.

sentences.en: And a paper bag is the best transport vehicle.
sentences.zh: 纸袋是最好的运输工具.
它们就像小型的鸟类救护车.

sentences.en: If you want to see this in action,
there's a video on YouTube of Caitlin helping stun birds in a New York City park.
sentences.zh: YouTube上有一段视频，展示了凯特琳在纽约市的一个公园里帮助救助撞晕的鸟.

sentences.en: Sort of let the bird out and let it choose to leave when it wants to.
sentences.zh: 有点像是把鸟放出来，让它在想离开的时候选择离开.

sentences.en: So I'm just going to open this bag.
sentences.zh: 所以我现在要打开这个袋子.

sentences.en: This bird is ready, ready, ready to go.
sentences.zh: 这只鸟已经准备好、准备好、准备好出发了.

sentences.en: We actually don't know how many of those birds makes it.
sentences.zh: 我们其实不知道其中有多少鸟能活下来.

sentences.en: We expect that many of them,
sentences.zh: 我们预计它们中的许多，

sentences.en: even if they recover from the immediate trauma,
sentences.zh: 即使它们从即时的创伤中恢复过来，

sentences.en: and probably often don't make it much further.
sentences.zh: 而且可能通常走不了多远.

sentences.en: stunned and wounded birds are the exception.
sentences.zh: 被撞晕和受伤的鸟只是少数特例.

sentences.en: Most birds that collide with buildings are killed instantly.
sentences.zh: 大多数与建筑物相撞的鸟类都是当场死亡.

sentences.en: The Audubon volunteers spent a lot of their time
sentences.zh: 奥杜邦的志愿者们花了很多时间

sentences.en: and bringing them back to a freezer at their office in Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 并将它们带回曼哈顿办公室的冰箱里.

sentences.en: Eventually, those carcasses get donated to museums for museum collections.
sentences.zh: 最终，这些尸体会被捐赠给博物馆作为博物馆藏品.

sentences.en: It's kind of a nice way of having these birds
sentences.zh: 这算是一种不错的方式，让这些鸟

sentences.en: go to some sort of useful scientific or educational purpose
sentences.zh: 走向某种有用的科学或教育用途，
因为它们是被无辜杀害的.

sentences.en: But it somehow feels a little bit better
sentences.zh: 但不知何故，感觉稍微好一点的是

sentences.en: that at least they're going towards some greater good.
sentences.zh: 至少它们的牺牲是为了某种更大的利益.

sentences.en: Still, these collision walks are really difficult
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，这些撞击寻迹散步对纽约奥杜邦的志愿者和员工来说

sentences.en: for the volunteers and staff at NYC Audubon.
Caitlin Parkins vividly remembers a day last fall
sentences.zh: 凯特琳·帕金斯清晰地记得去年秋天的一天，

sentences.en: that lives in New York birder infamy,
sentences.zh: 那一天在纽约观鸟界臭名昭著，
当时有非常密集的迁徙.

sentences.en: There was also a pretty intense storm and low cloud cover,
sentences.zh: 还有一场相当强烈的风暴和低云层，

sentences.en: and that brings birds down low into the city.
sentences.zh: 这把鸟类压得很低，飞进了城市.

sentences.en: So I started getting text messages around 6.30 in the morning.
sentences.zh: 所以我大约在早上6点半开始接到短信.

sentences.en: I can't pick up all of these birds.
I'm trying to pick up the stunned birds.
sentences.zh: 我正试图捡起那些被撞晕的鸟.

sentences.en: I had a black pole warbler die in my hand.
sentences.zh: 我手里死了一只黑极林莺.

sentences.en: I watched it hit a window at Columbus Circle,
sentences.zh: 我看着它撞上了哥伦布圆环的一扇窗户，

sentences.en: and it was convulsing in my hand,
and there's nothing that I could do in that moment.
sentences.zh: 而在那一刻我什么也做不了。

sentences.en: I knew that bird was going to die.
sentences.zh: 我知道那只鸟快要死了。

sentences.en: The bird collisions that day were especially traumatic
sentences.zh: 那天发生的鸟类撞击事件格外令人痛心，
对于曼哈顿市中心的志愿者们来说，

sentences.en: particularly those who monitor the new towers
sentences.zh: 特别是那些负责监测新大楼的志愿者，

sentences.en: at the World Trade Center site.
sentences.zh: 也就是世界贸易中心遗址的那几栋。

sentences.en: Tower 4 is designed by Japanese architect
and it's known as Bird Enemy No.
sentences.zh: 它被称为“头号爱鸟杀手”，

sentences.en: The tower is basically a four-length mirror of a building,
sentences.zh: 这座大楼基本上就是个四面全是镜子的建筑，

sentences.en: and it's in exactly the wrong place.
The other aspect of why that particular site is deadly
sentences.zh: 为什么那个特定地点如此致命的另一个原因，

sentences.en: is the memorial grove of trees

sentences.zh: 它围绕着九一一事件遇难者

sentences.en: Those are a very broad tree canopy
sentences.zh: 那些树木有着非常宽阔的树冠，

sentences.en: that's right in close proximity to these buildings.
sentences.zh: 而且恰好紧邻这些建筑物。

sentences.en: That morning, a volunteer for NYC Audubon
sentences.zh: 那天早上，一位纽约奥杜逊学会的志愿者

sentences.en: got to the World Trade Center buildings,
and what she found became big news around the world.
sentences.zh: 她所发现的事情成了轰动全球的新闻。

sentences.en: She went to the World Trade Center site,
and she found over 200 dead birds there that day.
sentences.zh: 那天她在那里发现了两百多只死鸟。

sentences.en: And she actually arranged them in kind of a grid
sentences.zh: 她实际上把它们排成了一个网格状，

sentences.en: and attached the photos to the tweet,
sentences.zh: 并将照片发到了推特上，

sentences.en: and I really think it went viral
sentences.zh: 我真的觉得它之所以走红，

sentences.en: that many, like, tiny, fragile dead birds
sentences.zh: 那么多像这样微小而脆弱的死鸟

sentences.en: all in one tweet was just very overwhelming.
sentences.zh: 全都在一条推文里，实在太震撼了。

sentences.en: It was picked up on Twitter.
It was picked up by the media.
We started getting all kinds of media inquiries.
sentences.zh: 我们开始接到各种各样的媒体咨询。

sentences.en: As terrible as that event was,
sentences.zh: 尽管那场事件极其糟糕，

sentences.en: it brought a lot of awareness to the issue.
sentences.zh: 但它让人们对这个问题有了很多认识。

sentences.en: not an acceptable state of affairs.
These are really some of the newest,
sentences.zh: 这些确实是最新的一些建筑，
也是纽约最闪亮的建筑。

sentences.en: Why are we allowing them, you know,
sentences.zh: 为什么我们允许它们，你知道的，

sentences.en: When it comes to bird collisions,
there's a lot we can do.
sentences.zh: 我们能做的事其实很多。

sentences.en: we can turn off lights and empty skyscrapers,
sentences.zh: 我们可以关掉灯光并关闭空置的摩天大楼，

sentences.en: which are tempting for migrating birds.
sentences.zh: 这些对迁徙的鸟类有着极大的诱惑。

sentences.en: good design can go a long way.
sentences.zh: 优秀的设计可以发挥巨大作用。

sentences.en: In fact, there are design solutions
sentences.zh: 事实上，有些设计解决方案

sentences.en: that can bring down bird deaths by 80 or 90%.
sentences.zh: 可以将鸟类死亡率降低80%到90%。
而且它们相当简单直接。

sentences.en: It's all about making buildings more legible for birds.
sentences.zh: 关键在于让建筑物对鸟类来说更加清晰可辨。

sentences.en: You can break up an all-glass facade
sentences.zh: 你可以用彩色的竖框或实体屏障

sentences.en: with colored fins or solid barriers.
Or you can design a building with bird-safe glass
sentences.zh: 或者你可以用防鸟撞的玻璃来设计建筑，

sentences.en: that's covered in patterns or small dots
sentences.zh: 上面覆盖着图案或小圆点，

sentences.en: so a bird doesn't see the glass as transparent.
sentences.zh: 这样鸟儿就不会把玻璃看作是透明的了。
根据亚历山德拉·兰格的说法，

sentences.en: there are many great examples of bird-safe design
sentences.zh: 纽约的天际线上有很多绝佳的防鸟撞设计范例。
比如，我认为最好的例子之一

sentences.en: Like, I think one of the best examples
is the New York Times building,
sentences.zh: 它是由伦佐·皮亚诺设计的，

sentences.en: which was designed by Renzo Piano
